info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Etas-v3-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery ETA Retrieval API provides timely updates on estimated arrival times for deliveries. It allows users to access the ETA for food deliveries in real-time, improving transparency and customer experience. Typical consumers include delivery service providers and application developers integrating ETA functionalities into their systems. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and customer satisfaction through accurate delivery tracking.

get.summary: Retrieve the estimated delivery time for a shipment.
get.description: This endpoint calculates and returns the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for a specified delivery based on the current location and delivery address. It considers various factors such as distance, traffic, and carrier performance to provide an accurate ETA.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving estimated time of arrival (ETA) for deliveries. It includes parameters necessary for the calculation of ETA based on the provided delivery details.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesEtasRequest.description: A schema representing the request body for the GET operation on deliveries ETA.
